title: Business Development Executive
description:
We are currently working with an established and reputable main contractor to recruit a Business Development Executive to support its continued growth and strengthen its position across key construction sectors.

With a strong track record the business delivers a diverse range of construction, refurbishment, new-build and specialist projects across London, the South East. Its portfolio includes education, healthcare, commercial, residential, heritage and community projects, underpinned by a commitment to quality, client relationships and successful project delivery.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded and proactive Business Development Executive to join an established construction business, helping identify new opportunities, develop relationships and contribute to its ongoing growth.

The Role

Working closely with the business development and pre-construction teams, you will play a key role in identifying new business opportunities, developing relationships with prospective clients and consultants, and supporting the company's wider growth strategy.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Identifying and developing new business opportunities across relevant construction sectors.
- Building and maintaining relationships with clients, architects, consultants, quantity surveyors and other key industry contacts.
- Researching forthcoming construction projects, procurement opportunities and potential routes to market.
- Monitoring public-sector frameworks, tender portals and project pipelines to identify suitable opportunities.
- Supporting the preparation of PQQs, tender submissions, presentations and other pre-construction documentation.
- Arranging and attending client meetings, networking events and industry functions to strengthen the company's market presence.
- Maintaining an accurate CRM system, recording client interactions and tracking potential opportunities.
- Working collaboratively with estimating, pre-construction and operational teams to support successful business development activity.
- Monitoring market trends, competitor activity and client requirements to identify opportunities for future growth.

The Ideal Candidate

We are keen to hear from candidates with a background in business development, sales, client relationship management or bid coordination, ideally within the construction or wider built environment sector.

You will be a confident communicator with strong relationship-building skills and a proactive approach to identifying and developing new opportunities.

The successful candidate will ideally demonstrate:
- Experience in a business development, sales or client-facing role.
- An understanding of the construction industry and its procurement processes.
- The ability to research projects, identify decision-makers and develop new client relationships.
- Strong written communication skills, with experience contributing to proposals, presentations or tender submissions.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
- A commercially aware mindset, with the confidence to engage with clients and industry professionals at different levels.
- A motivated, professional and collaborative approach.

If you are an ambitious Business Development Executive looking for your next opportunity within the construction sector, we would be keen to hear from you.

Please submit your CV for a confidential discussion about this opportunity.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Build your career in business development and financial services.

Fortrade is looking for ambitious and confident people to join our Watford team as Business Development Executives.

If you have experience in sales, business development, recruitment, account management, customer service, retail or hospitality, your skills could transfer well into this role.

You'll work with clients who have already registered and shown an interest in Fortrade. You'll build professional relationships, understand client needs, introduce our platform and products, and develop those relationships.

This is not cold calling.

Key responsibilities:
- Build and develop professional relationships with clients
- Communicate confidently and understand client needs
- Introduce clients to our platform, products and services
- Provide information about financial markets and educational resources
- Identify opportunities to develop client relationships
- Work towards individual and team performance targets

What we're looking for:
- Strong communication skills
- Commercial awareness and a results-focused approach
- Ambition and motivation
- Resilience and willingness to learn
- Ability to take coaching and apply feedback
- Strong relationship-building skills
- Ability to work in a fast-paced office environment

No finance degree or previous financial markets experience is required.

Career progression

This role provides an opportunity to develop your skills within financial services, with opportunities to progress towards Senior Account Manager or Team Leader roles based on performance, development and business requirements.

We've seen people progress to Senior Account Manager in as little as four months.

What we offer:
- £26,500 starting salary
- £27,500 after probation
- Performance incentives
- Earning potential of £35,000 £38,000 including base salary and performance incentives
- Fully paid training
- Ongoing coaching and development
- Annual salary increases
- Pension
- Free on-site parking

Training starts Monday 19 October 2026. Successful candidates will complete a one-week fully paid training programme covering the platform, products, communication and compliance. Training forms part of the selection process and is followed by a Final Interview.

Fortrade is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), FRN (phone number removed). The role operates in an execution-only environment and does not involve providing personal financial advice.

Apply now to start your career in business development and financial services.

title: Customer Service Coordinator
description:
Customer Service Coordinator

Permanent Opportunity
Based in Stevenage
Monday to Friday 9:00am - 5:00pm 100% Office Based
Permanent Salary: 28,000 - 30,000 per annum (depending on experience)

Are you passionate about delivering exceptional customer service and building strong client relationships? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same?

Our client is a prestigious and well-established packaging organisation with an excellent reputation for quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Due to continued growth, they are looking to recruit a Customer Service Coordinator to join their friendly and supportive team.

The Role

As a Customer Service Coordinator, you will play a vital role in supporting customers and distributors, ensuring every enquiry and order is managed efficiently from start to finish. You'll build long-term relationships with customers, identify opportunities to grow existing accounts, and deliver an outstanding customer experience at every stage.

Key Responsibilities
- Build strong, long-lasting relationships with distributors through proactive and professional communication.
- Take ownership of customer enquiries and orders, managing them through to successful completion.
- Process customer orders and quotations accurately within agreed timescales.
- Recommend suitable products and prepare quotations tailored to customer requirements.
- Follow up quotations and provide regular feedback to the Customer Service Manager.
- Identify opportunities to upsell products and maximise customer value.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
- Monitor sales trends and proactively identify opportunities for growth.
- Become fully proficient in the company's internal systems.
- Maintain accurate records and ensure excellent attention to detail at all times.
- Support the wider team and undertake additional duties to contribute to the continued success of the business.

About You

We're looking for someone who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and providing first-class customer service. You will be organised, motivated, and confident communicating with customers over the phone and via email.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience within a customer service, customer support, sales support or account coordination role.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- A proactive, positive, and results-focused approach.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confidence working both independently and as part of a team.
- The ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
- Good IT skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems.
- A flexible approach and willingness to support the business when required.

What's on Offer?
- Permanent opportunity.
- Permanent salary of 28,000 - 30,000, depending on experience.
- Monday to Friday working hours (9:00am - 5:00pm).
- 100% office-based role in Stevenage
- Opportunity to join a prestigious and growing packaging organisation.
- Friendly, supportive team environment with genuine long-term career prospects.

If you're an enthusiastic Customer Service professional looking for your next challenge within a respected and growing business, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way.
